title: An Introduction to Geometric Group Theory
comment: 304 pages, in Portuguese language; v2: first revision; v3: revised following referees' comments
abstract: This book provides a self-contained introduction to geometric group theory. The topics range from an introduction of Cayley and Schreier graphs to Gromov's theorem on groups of polynomial growth and amenability. We discuss the ping-pong lemma, quasi-isometries, growth of groups, hyperbolicity, and other related notions. The book is based on graduate courses and can be used for such a course or for independent study.
